lessons.title: Getting started
lessons.summary: Learn how to sign in and reach your student workspace.
steps: Open the Student Login page and enter the phone number and password registered to your account.
After signing in, check that your name and student dashboard are displayed.
Use the dashboard navigation to find orders, FoodBack and support features.
Log out when using a shared device.

lessons.title: Explore restaurants
lessons.summary: Find a restaurant and browse its available meals.
steps: Open Explore Restaurants from the student dashboard.
Choose a restaurant to view its menu.
Check item names, descriptions and prices before adding food to your cart.
If a meal is marked unavailable, choose another available item.

lessons.title: Place an order
lessons.summary: Understand the ordering process before confirming.
steps: Select the meals and quantities you want.
Review the cart carefully, including the delivery fee and takeaway packaging charge shown at checkout.
Enter an accurate delivery location and any useful landmark details.
Review the final amount and follow the available checkout instructions.

lessons.title: Payments and receipts
lessons.summary: Understand payment status and what to do if something looks wrong.
steps: Use the payment option displayed at checkout.
Wait for the platform to show the payment or order status before trying again.
Do not share your password, one-time codes or payment credentials with anyone.
If payment appears successful but the order status is unclear, contact support with your order reference.

lessons.title: Using FoodBack
lessons.summary: Learn where FoodBack appears and how to check its status.
steps: Open the FoodBack or wallet area in your student dashboard when available.
Review your balance and transaction history before using a reward.
If an order paid with FoodBack requires admin review, wait for the platform's decision.
For a missing or disputed reward, contact support with the relevant order reference.

lessons.title: Track orders and get help
lessons.summary: Follow an order and report a problem clearly.
steps: Open your active or recent orders in the student dashboard.
Use the displayed status to understand whether the order is awaiting action, being prepared or out for delivery.
Keep your phone available and make sure your delivery location is accurate.
Use the support channel if the order is delayed, incorrect or marked complete unexpectedly.

lessons.title: Open your restaurant dashboard
lessons.summary: Sign in and understand the restaurant workspace.
steps: Open the Restaurant Login page and enter your restaurant credentials.
Check that your restaurant name is shown in the dashboard.
Use the dashboard sections to manage your menu and incoming orders.
Never share your login details with staff who do not need account access.

lessons.title: Manage your food menu
lessons.summary: Add and maintain accurate food listings.
steps: Open the menu management section in your restaurant dashboard.
Add a clear food name, description, price and suitable photo.
Review the details before saving the menu.
Update or remove items promptly when prices or availability change.

lessons.title: Go online, offline and mark food unavailable
steps: Use the restaurant availability control to go online when you can fulfil orders.
Go offline when the restaurant is closed or cannot accept orders.
Mark individual food items unavailable when they cannot be prepared.
Pause incoming orders if your kitchen needs time to catch up, where that control is available.

lessons.title: Receive and prepare orders
lessons.summary: Follow the order from receipt to pickup.
steps: Check incoming orders in the dashboard regularly while online.
Review each order's items and any student instructions.
Update the order status using the available dashboard controls as preparation progresses.
Mark the order ready for pickup only when it is prepared and ready for the assigned agent.

lessons.title: Apply for an advertisement
lessons.summary: Submit an advertisement for admin review.
steps: Open the advertisement application area in your restaurant dashboard, if available to your account.
Enter an accurate title, description, image URL and destination.
Choose the package and review the displayed price and duration.
Submit the application and check its status; an application is not active until approved and payment is confirmed by the admin.

lessons.title: Understand settlements and support
lessons.summary: Know where to check settlement information.
steps: Use the settlement or payout information provided by ChowOnCampus and Paystack.
Remember that order sales and a confirmed bank credit are not the same thing.
Keep your order references and settlement records for reconciliation.
Contact support if a settlement is missing or the recorded amount does not match your bank statement.

lessons.title: Open your agent dashboard
lessons.summary: Sign in and review your delivery workspace.
steps: Open the Delivery Agent Login page and enter your agent credentials.
Check your name and availability status at the top of the dashboard.
Review notifications and your assigned delivery area.
Keep your login details private and log out on shared devices.

lessons.title: Manage your availability
lessons.summary: Control when you can receive delivery assignments.
steps: Go online only when you are ready to accept deliveries.
Go offline when you are unavailable or finishing your shift.
Keep your location permission enabled when the platform requests it for delivery coordination.
If your availability does not update, refresh the dashboard and contact support if the issue continues.

lessons.title: Accept and collect a delivery
steps: Review the pickup restaurant and destination details shown for the offer.
Accept the delivery only if you can complete it safely and within the platform's service area.
Travel to the restaurant and confirm collection only after the order is handed to you.
Update the delivery status using the dashboard controls.

lessons.title: Complete the student handover
lessons.summary: Use the delivery confirmation process correctly.
steps: At the destination, ask the student to provide the order's four-character handover code.
Enter the code only after the student has received the correct order.
Submit the code through the delivery dashboard to complete the order.
If the code fails or the student cannot access it, do not guess; contact support for assistance.

lessons.title: Check deliveries and earnings
lessons.summary: Understand your performance and payment records.
steps: Open the monthly earnings section of your dashboard.
Check successful deliveries and the earnings recorded for the selected month.
Compare recorded payments with your own bank or wallet records.
Ask support or an administrator to review any discrepancy; dashboard records alone are not proof of a transfer.

lessons.title: Professional delivery and privacy
steps: Use customer information only to complete the assigned delivery.
Do not share a student's address, phone number or order details with others.
Communicate politely and use only the contact options provided by the platform.
If a delivery feels unsafe or the order details are inconsistent, stop and contact support.

faqs.question: Where can I find restaurants?
faqs.answer: Open Explore Restaurants from your student dashboard to browse restaurants and their menus.

faqs.question: Why is a food item unavailable?
faqs.answer: The restaurant may have marked the item unavailable. Choose another available item or check again later.

faqs.question: What fees will I pay?
faqs.answer: Review the checkout summary. It displays the delivery fee, takeaway packaging charge and any other applicable amount before you confirm.

faqs.question: What if my payment succeeds but my order does not update?
faqs.answer: Do not immediately pay again. Save your order reference and contact ChowOnCampus support at 09169398221 or chowoncampus@gmail.com.

faqs.question: How do I track my order?
faqs.answer: Open your student dashboard and check the active order status.

faqs.question: How do I use FoodBack?
faqs.answer: Check the FoodBack or wallet section in your dashboard for your balance and available actions.

faqs.question: Why is my FoodBack order awaiting review?
faqs.answer: Some FoodBack orders require an administrator to review them. Wait for the dashboard status or contact support.

faqs.question: Can I change my delivery location after ordering?
faqs.answer: Do not assume a location change has been accepted. Contact support with your order reference as soon as possible.

faqs.question: My order is late. What should I do?
faqs.answer: Check the latest order status, keep your phone available and contact support if you need help.

faqs.question: How do I report a wrong or missing item?
faqs.answer: Contact support with your order reference and a short description of the issue.

faqs.question: How do I add a meal?
faqs.answer: Open menu management, add the food name, description, price and photo, then save your menu.

faqs.question: How do I stop receiving orders?
faqs.answer: Use the availability control to go offline or the pause incoming orders control if it is available.

faqs.question: How do I mark a meal unavailable?
faqs.answer: Open your menu manager and change the item's availability using its available control.

faqs.question: Why can't I receive orders?
faqs.answer: Your account may be offline, suspended, awaiting verification or otherwise restricted. Check the dashboard message and contact support if unclear.

faqs.question: How do I update a food price?
faqs.answer: Edit the item in your menu manager and save the updated menu.

faqs.question: Where do ad applications go?
faqs.answer: Submitted applications are reviewed in the Ultimate Admin Advertising & Promotions Campaign Manager.

faqs.question: When will my advertisement appear?
faqs.answer: It appears only after the application is approved, payment is confirmed by the admin and the campaign becomes active.

faqs.question: Does submitting an ad mean it is paid?
faqs.answer: No. Submission creates an application for review. Payment confirmation is a separate administrative step.

faqs.question: Where do I check settlement details?
faqs.answer: Check the settlement information available in your dashboard and reconcile it against your bank statement.

faqs.question: Who do I contact about an order issue?
faqs.answer: Contact ChowOnCampus support at 09169398221 or chowoncampus@gmail.com and include the order reference.

faqs.question: How do I receive deliveries?
faqs.answer: Go online when you are available. Eligible delivery offers will appear in your agent dashboard.

faqs.question: Can I accept a delivery if I am unavailable?
faqs.answer: No. Only accept an offer when you can complete it safely and within the required service area.

faqs.question: When should I confirm pickup?
faqs.answer: Confirm collection only after the restaurant has handed the prepared order to you.

faqs.question: How do I complete a delivery?
faqs.answer: Ask the student for the four-character handover code after handing over the correct order, then enter it in the dashboard.

faqs.question: What if the handover code does not work?
faqs.answer: Do not guess repeatedly. Check the order and code with the student, then contact support if it still fails.

faqs.question: How do I check my earnings?
faqs.answer: Open the monthly earnings section and select the month you want to review.

faqs.question: Does the dashboard payment record prove I was paid?
faqs.answer: No. Compare it with your bank or wallet record and contact an administrator about any difference.

faqs.question: Can I share student contact details?
faqs.answer: No. Student information is private and must only be used to complete the assigned delivery.

faqs.question: What if I need to go offline during a delivery?
faqs.answer: Complete or safely hand over your current assignment according to platform instructions, then change your availability.

faqs.question: Who do I contact if an assignment is incorrect?
faqs.answer: Contact ChowOnCampus support at 09169398221 or chowoncampus@gmail.com with the order reference.
